package.name: dpcbf_plot_client
package.description: Read-only live plotting client for the DPCBF perception+control stack — the ONLY thing Computer 3 (the operator laptop) runs. Subscribes to /dpcbf/plot (control-seam sample), /odom and, when the message package is available, /obstacles_safe; renders a 2-D top-down view and command/ barrier time series with explicit per-source staleness. Publishes nothing a robot could act on; a crash or disconnect here is invisible to the control side by construction (BestEffort subscriptions only). Includes the synthetic publisher used to verify the whole path without a robot. Minimal Computer 3 install: this package + dpcbf_viz_msgs.
